name: muster
description: The executive team a solo founder cannot afford to hire: six roles with their own remits and memory, one chief-of-staff brief a day, and a money invariant enforced by tool grants — no agent can spend.

interface.shortDescription: The executive team a solo founder cannot afford to hire
interface.longDescription: Six roles with real remits and their own memory — delivery, architecture, QA, counsel, finance and brand. Each asks a standing question every run, a chief of staff caps what reaches you at five items, and no agent can spend your money.
